description: Source code implementing a vector data structure for Segmentation and Reassembly (SAR) payloads, including functions for validation, initialization, appending, destruction, retrieval, and serialization.

methods.name: IsValidPayload
methods.description: Validates if a new SAR payload can be appended based on session ID and sequence ID.

methods.name: SAR_VECTOR_Append
methods.description: Appends a new payload to the SAR vector if valid, performing a deep copy of data.

methods.name: SAR_VECTOR_Destroy
methods.description: Deallocates all memory associated with the SAR vector.

methods.name: SAR_VECTOR_Get
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to a payload at a specified index in the vector.

methods.name: SAR_VECTOR_Serialize
methods.description: Serializes all payloads into a contiguous buffer, ownership transferred to caller.
